consequence.statement: Environments that were hitting the failure caused by GitHub's deprecation of the use of status checks stop failing once upgraded to 0.16.0; the evidence states no operator action beyond upgrading.
consequence.remediation: Upgrade to 0.16.0; the evidence states no operator action beyond upgrading.

original.statement: external-secrets 0.16.0 fixes a failure that occurred because GitHub deprecated the use of status checks.

consequence.statement: No operational consequence for operators: the change only touches the upstream project's CI workflow (.github/workflows/e2e.yml) and removes a step that failed after GitHub changed how check-run statuses can be modified. The shipped product does not change.

corrected.statement: PR #4640 in external-secrets 0.16.0 removes a status-check step from the project's own e2e GitHub Actions workflow (.github/workflows/e2e.yml) because the step kept failing after a GitHub Actions deprecation. Operator environments see no change.

decision.reason: The linked PR [ev-4b67f9e77498] says the failure was in the project's own e2e CI step, which kept failing after GitHub Actions changed how check-run statuses can be modified, so the maintainers removed that step. Its only changed file is .github/workflows/e2e.yml [ev-fad7ab0ec433]. The release note [ev-493f55a0e705] is just the PR title. Nothing in the shipped product changes, so no operator environment was hitting this failure or behaves differently after upgrading. The consequence is none (informational), not behavior-change (review).
